title: run: days resolved, stopping for an interrupt
description: The answer of run: the staff's orders for its first day, worked before that day was resolved (as staff_orders gives them), the days resolved, why it stopped and everything that fired on the last day, together.

stopped.description: told: the staff handed in, on the last day resolved, a notice you asked to stop on (stop_on; decision 0220, R11); interrupt: an interrupt of yours fired on the last day resolved; game_over: the game ended; days: the number of days asked for was resolved; asks_leave: at dusk, before the next day, your staff would hand in a force's asking leave to pursue a find (decision 0214, rule 7): nothing was resolved by the stop, and days_resolved has the days of the call before it (count 0 where it stopped before the first).

stop_on.description: Given only where you asked for stops: the notices of following the call stops after a day on (decision 0220, R11).

told.description: Given only where one of stop_on came on the last day resolved: the notice, with the numbers of its events and the staff's words, naming the force by its report.

asking.description: Given only with asks_leave: each asking, a force's, in your numbers.

day.description: The number of days resolved: the day now.

result.description: When game_over is true and the scenario has objectives, the umpire's result for both sides; otherwise null.
